seo.title: About - NexusContent Example
seo.description: How NexusContent separates content from application code.

hero.heading: Separation, by design.
hero.intro: NexusContent keeps the boundary between content sources and content consumers clean.

image.alt: A team collaborating around a table

mission.content: Our mission. Give frontend applications a single, predictable content interface regardless of where the content lives.

story.content: Our story. NexusContent began with one question: why should a website be rebuilt every time a content source changes? The answer is a thin, framework-neutral layer that normalizes content once and lets applications stay focused on presentation.

principles.content:
Principles.

  • Astro owns routing.
  • Core stays provider independent.
  • Editable content lives outside the app.
  • Static generation remains the default.
  • Missing content fails loudly.
